review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. du throughout (the team and the Gemeinde use first names and du; a free church). "Gemeinde" = the local congregation; "Gottesdienst" = the Sunday service. A church vocabulary of the Freikirchen (Hauskreis, Lobpreis) is not used yet; a Landeskirche would say "Pfarrer" for Pastor. "Das ist eine gute Woche" is a plain, mild remark.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Es ist Abend in der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: It is evening at the church.

sentences.text: Thomas, David, Ruth und Sam sind da.
sentences.english: Thomas, David, Ruth and Sam are there.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: Good evening!

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Wir sind in der Küche der Kirche.
sentences.english: We are in the church kitchen.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: Hello, Thomas!

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: Hello, Sam!

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Good evening, Sam!

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.text: Du bist da, das ist gut!
sentences.english: You are here, that is good!

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.text: Was machen wir in der Woche?
sentences.english: What are we doing this week?

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: On Sunday there is the service.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Der Gottesdienst fängt um zehn Uhr an.
sentences.english: The service starts at ten o'clock.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: In der Gemeinde wollen wir Lieder singen.
sentences.english: In the church we want to sing songs.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Who can sing a song?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich kann nicht gut singen, aber ich will lernen.
sentences.english: I cannot sing well, but I want to learn.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: That is good, Sam.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: We can learn together.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Das Lied ist in der Bibel.
sentences.english: The song is in the Bible.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: Here is the Bible.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: We learn in the Bible.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: You can pray too, Sam.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Ich bete gern, aber ich spreche nicht viel Deutsch.
sentences.english: I like praying, but I do not speak much German.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Speak freely, even if it is not good.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.text: David ist mein Freund, und du bist auch ein Freund, Sam.
sentences.english: David is my friend, and you are a friend too, Sam.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Thank you, Ruth.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: That is very nice.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Nach dem Gottesdienst ist das Mittagessen.
sentences.english: After the service there is lunch.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Who is to cook?

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: Marta likes cooking.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: She makes soup and meat.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: I will cook potatoes.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: And who makes cake?

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: Marta makes cake too.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: It is so tasty!

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What should I do?

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Can you do the shopping?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Yes, I can do the shopping.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.text: Du kaufst Tomaten und Äpfel, zwei Kilo.
sentences.english: You buy tomatoes and apples, two kilos.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: What is the price?

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.text: Du darfst nicht zu viel kaufen.
sentences.english: You must not buy too much.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Gut, ich kaufe zwei Kilo Tomaten und ein Kilo Äpfel.
sentences.english: Good, I will buy two kilos of tomatoes and one kilo of apples.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Soll ich um zehn Uhr da sein?
sentences.english: Should I be there at ten o'clock?

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: Yes, Sam.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Wir sind alle hier, wir wollen helfen.
sentences.english: We are all here, we want to help.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: I will help in the kitchen.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I will help too.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Sam ist ein guter Freund von der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: Sam is a good friend of the church.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: That is a good week!
It is half past eight.
They have one hour.

sentences.text: Dann ist Pause mit Kaffee und Kuchen.
sentences.english: Then there is a break with coffee and cake.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Ben kommt mit Mama und Papa in die Kirche.
sentences.english: Ben is coming to church with Mama and Papa.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: That is nice!

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.english: Ben is always so good.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Am Sonntag fahre ich mit der Straßenbahn.
sentences.english: On Sunday I will take the tram.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Die Straßenbahn fährt um neun Uhr ab.
sentences.english: The tram leaves at nine o'clock.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.english: Good.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.text: Die Sonne ist am Sonntag warm, das ist immer schön.
sentences.english: The sun is warm on Sunday, that is always nice.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.text: Auf der Straße ist es am Sonntag schön.
sentences.english: On the street it is nice on Sunday.
They pray for the week.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Anna und Lukas kommen auch in die Kirche.
sentences.english: Anna and Lukas are coming to church too.

sentences.speaker: david
sentences.text: Anna ist müde, sie arbeitet viel in der Klinik.
sentences.english: Anna is tired, she works a lot at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: ruth
sentences.text: Lukas ist Lehrer, er hat Schule am Morgen.
sentences.english: Lukas is a teacher, he has school in the morning.
